title: Divergence: LeanEngine::evidence_key omits the obligation CONTENT (+ seed, thermite_version) — a changed contract on a same-named item keeps the same key (§2(d)/REQ-7 staleness)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Code cite (forge/src/engine.rs, fn LeanEngine::evidence_key @ d4871ded): the hash composes item NAME + class.tag + role.tag + spec_def NAMES + toolchain_rev + spine_content_hash + LEAN_SCHEMA_VERSION. §2(d) (F4) requires '{obligation content, seed, ENGINE name, ENGINE-TOOLCHAIN version, TARGETED-SPINE content hash, thermite_version, schema_version}' and REQ-7(ii) keys proof staleness on 'obligation hash'. o.ast_slice / o.env.params / the req+ens exprs / spec-fn BODIES are never hashed: editing 'ens result >= a' to 'ens result >= b' (or editing a reached spec-fn's body) yields the IDENTICAL key, so a cached/replayed Proven would silently survive a contract change — exactly the never-silently-reused rule REQ-7 states. seed and thermite_version are also absent. No kernel pin is possible (Rust-only); the regression test must live in engine.rs's #[cfg(test)] mod (forge is a binary crate — the critic cannot add it without editing production files): assert evidence_key differs for two same-named items with different ens. Note (acceptable, recorded): spine_content_hash walks lean/Thermite/*.lean NON-recursively — lean/Thermite/Exec/** is unhashed, which is fine for the pure-contract targeted set {Ast,Denote,Stabilize} but must widen when increment (iv) targets Exec.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: commit the three kernel pins for the #240 re-audit (PinExportUndefinedCallee/#243, PinExportBoolResult/#244, PinExportCapture/#245 — all lake-env-lean green, lake build untouched-green 368 jobs); #246 itself carries no pin (Rust-only, binary crate) — its regression test must land in engine.rs's test mod with the generator's fix. No production code is touched; the pins are the audit artifacts.
